title: Suggestions Beta — Target Accounts & Selection Criteria (Batching/Caching, Console)
content:
Purpose
- Identify a short list of customer orgs to enable for the Optimization Suggestions (batching/caching) beta in Console.
- Prioritize accounts with strong telemetry maturity so savings + risk labels are credible.
- Ensure we cover a spread of segments (startup → enterprise), latency profiles (interactive chat vs async), and deployment modes.

Scope reminders (beta)
- Suggestions limited to batching + caching only.
- No auto-apply. Customers must explicitly apply changes and use rollout controls.
- Savings shown are estimates (not contractual).

Selection criteria (scoring rubric)
- Telemetry readiness (0–3)
  - 3: Has request rate, token counts, p50/p95 latency distributions, cache metrics (hit rate/prefix cache), route/model tags; stable over last 7–14 days.
  - 2: Has request rate + latency + token counts; cache metrics partial OR sampling gaps.
  - 1: Has basic request rate only; missing token/latency breakdowns.
  - 0: Insufficient telemetry or pipeline lag >24h.
- Cost sensitivity (0–3)
  - 3: Actively optimizing spend; has internal cost targets; meaningful $/day opportunity.
  - 2: Cost-aware; expects ROI narrative.
  - 1: Not actively optimizing; mostly performance-driven.
  - 0: Low usage.
- Operational maturity / risk tolerance (0–2)
  - 2: Has SLOs/alerts and uses rollout controls; willing to run controlled experiments.
  - 1: Some controls; ad-hoc changes.
  - 0: No change management; high blast radius.
- Comms + feedback loop (0–2)
  - 2: Named technical POC + cadence; agrees to provide feedback (and screenshots) within 1–2 weeks.
  - 1: POC but low bandwidth.
  - 0: No clear owner.

Eligibility gates (hard requirements)
- Must be on Redwood Console v2026.03 preview channel OR willing to enable feature flag.
- Must have Optimize Suggestions RBAC permission path identified (Org admin / Project admin / Optimize viewer).
- Must not require pre-approval of UI copy beyond standard beta disclaimer (some regulated enterprise teams do).

Outreach owner mapping
- PLG/self-serve customers: Miguel Santos (CS) + Marissa Cole (PM) for intro.
- Sales-led/enterprise: Account owner (Sales) + CS; PM joins for technical trust-building on risk/savings.

Legend (statuses)
- Not contacted
- Intro sent
- Discovery scheduled
- Awaiting security review
- Awaiting telemetry validation
- Enabled (feature flag)
- Active (sending feedback)
- Paused (issues)
- Declined

Cost pressure is real; expects conservative estimates and clear assumptions.
next_actions: Marissa: finalize wave-1 list (3–5 accounts) by 2026-02-28; align with PM-857 staged rollout.
Miguel: send follow-ups to Northstar Support + Aperture LegalTech; lock weekly feedback cadence (30 min).
Logan/Nadia: run telemetry readiness checks for HelioHR + Crescent EdTech; confirm whether token/latency aggregates are complete for last 14 days.
Marcus: pre-screen Arkadia Finance security questions; confirm if beta copy can be enabled without formal UI review.
Dylan/Chloe: confirm feature-flag enable/rollback steps and auditing expectations for wave 1 (link internal how-to).
George: recruit 2 accounts from wave 1 for usability study tasks (risk label comprehension + “why we recommend this”).
open_questions: Do we require cache metrics for eligibility, or can we still show batching-only suggestions with a clear “cache telemetry missing” banner?
What is the minimum telemetry lookback window for stable estimates (7d vs 14d) for bursty accounts?
Do we allow enterprise accounts to screenshot/share the Suggestions UI internally (copy includes ‘beta’ watermark)?
How do we handle accounts with multiple projects: do we require per-project enablement, or org-wide flag with project RBAC filtering?
notes_for_support: If an enabled beta customer reports “estimate doesn’t match billing”, ask for: org id, project id, route name, model, time window, and stale_as_of timestamp shown in UI. Remind: estimates exclude downstream costs (e.g., retries, non-LLM infra) and are based on observed distributions. Escalate to Optimize Suggestions on-call if discrepancy >20% persists after confirming time window + staleness.
